raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delayed recruitment of key PIU staff (technical coordinator, environmental/social head, etc.) could hinder project start‑up.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare detailed TORs and start recruitment before loan effectiveness; use interim consultants if needed; enforce two‑month hiring deadline.",
      "evidence": "FM risk section notes delayed recruitment of FM staff; PIU must appoint key staff within two months after effectiveness."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Budget allocation and execution delays may postpone implementation and disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Initiate budget allocation immediately after loan signing; establish monthly execution tracking and corrective action plan.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary section cites budget allocation and execution delays as a risk to project readiness and disbursement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "GORE Arequipa PIU lacks experience managing World Bank‑financed projects, risking fiduciary and ESG compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement targeted training on WB fiduciary, procurement, ESG standards; assign experienced external advisors to mentor PIU staff.",
      "evidence": "Implementation section states GORE lacks experience with WB‑financed projects, requiring capacity building for fiduciary, environmental, and social aspects."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Heavy rains, floods, landslides and seismic activity could damage upgraded roads and tourism sites.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate‑resilient engineering (drainage, slope stabilization, seismic design); conduct hazard mapping and third‑party design reviews.",
      "evidence": "Key climate and natural hazard risks include heavy rains, flooding, landslides, and high seismic activity affecting infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Failure to secure required Interinstitutional Agreements with municipalities may block disbursements.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Negotiate template agreements early; obtain signatures from all participating municipalities before first disbursement; monitor compliance.",
      "evidence": "Disbursement condition: no withdrawals until Bank receives at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Fragmented coordination among ministries, regional and local authorities could cause implementation delays.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define clear TORs for steering and consultative committees; schedule regular joint meetings and shared reporting mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Steering and consultative committees are established to coordinate across ministries and levels of government."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Complex procurement environment and limited experience may lead to procurement delays or non‑compliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Finalize Project Procurement Strategy Document; train logistics office staff; use standard WB bidding documents for all procurements.",
      "evidence": "Procurement will follow WB regulations; GORE’s logistics office prepared a Project Procurement Strategy Document."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Private sector investment may not materialize, reducing leverage and expected job creation.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop PPP frameworks and investment promotion packages; secure pre‑qualification of private partners; provide fiscal incentives and risk guarantees.",
      "evidence": "Private investors are preparing a US$126 million program contingent on upgraded infrastructure and tourism flows."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Global tourism demand shocks (e.g., new pandemic, recession) could lower arrivals and revenue.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Diversify source markets (domestic, regional, niche); strengthen digital marketing; create flexible tourism products to adapt to demand shifts.",
      "evidence": "Tourism contributed 9.3 % of GDP; pandemic caused severe drop; future arrivals depend on global demand."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Risks of sexual exploitation and harassment may affect women participants and staff.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Enforce SEA/SH Action Plan, conduct awareness training, establish confidential reporting channels, monitor incidents regularly.",
      "evidence": "Project includes SEA/SH Action Plan to address sexual exploitation and harassment risks."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Construction activities could cause environmental degradation if mitigation measures are insufficient.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement Environmental Management Plan; use low‑impact construction techniques; monitor reforestation progress; manage waste responsibly.",
      "evidence": "Component includes reforestation of 174 ha and mitigation measures such as PV panels and drainage."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Delay in signing the Cooperation Agreement between MINCETUR and GORE may postpone fund utilization.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set a firm deadline for signing; assign legal team to track progress; involve Bank liaison to ensure timely execution.",
      "evidence": "Cooperation Agreement between MINCETUR and GORE must be signed in form satisfactory to the Bank."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Cost overruns on road and infrastructure works could exhaust the allocated budget.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Use detailed cost estimates with contingency reserve; conduct independent cost reviews; monitor expenditures monthly and adjust forecasts.",
      "evidence": "Road upgrades involve extensive civil works; cost overruns are a common risk in large infrastructure projects."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Insufficient maintenance arrangements may lead to rapid degradation of upgraded assets.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create an O&M fund, train local operators, establish maintenance contracts with clear performance indicators.",
      "evidence": "Design includes maintenance arrangements to ensure sustainability of improved roads."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Inadequate stakeholder engagement could generate grievances and community opposition.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Roll out Stakeholder Engagement Plan; hold community workshops; maintain transparent grievance redress mechanism with timely response.",
      "evidence": "Borrower must prepare and implement Stakeholder Engagement Plan and grievance mechanism."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Political instability or changes in regional leadership may affect project continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Obtain multi‑year political commitments; embed project in regional development plan; maintain continuous dialogue with elected officials.",
      "evidence": "Recent years have seen increased political instability; project relies on GORE Arequipa governance."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Non‑compliance with environmental and social safeguards could trigger Bank sanctions.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Develop and implement ESMP; conduct regular compliance audits; provide staff training on safeguards and reporting.",
      "evidence": "Environmental and Social Risk Classification is Substantial; FM risk rated Substantial, requiring safeguards compliance."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Data gaps for M&E indicators (e.g., lodging arrivals) may impair performance monitoring.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set up dedicated data collection unit; formalize data sharing agreements with MINCETUR/INEI; use digital platform for real‑time monitoring.",
      "evidence": "M&E relies on data from MINCETUR, INEI, and new surveys; baseline and periodic data collection required."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Delayed recruitment of key PIU staff (technical coordinator, environmental/social head, etc.) could hinder project start‑up.
risks.mitigation: Prepare detailed TORs and start recruitment before loan effectiveness; use interim consultants if needed; enforce two‑month hiring deadline.
risks.evidence: FM risk section notes delayed recruitment of FM staff; PIU must appoint key staff within two months after effectiveness.

risks.description: Budget allocation and execution delays may postpone implementation and disbursements.
risks.mitigation: Initiate budget allocation immediately after loan signing; establish monthly execution tracking and corrective action plan.
risks.evidence: Fiduciary section cites budget allocation and execution delays as a risk to project readiness and disbursement.

risks.description: GORE Arequipa PIU lacks experience managing World Bank‑financed projects, risking fiduciary and ESG compliance.
risks.mitigation: Implement targeted training on WB fiduciary, procurement, ESG standards; assign experienced external advisors to mentor PIU staff.
risks.evidence: Implementation section states GORE lacks experience with WB‑financed projects, requiring capacity building for fiduciary, environmental, and social aspects.

risks.description: Heavy rains, floods, landslides and seismic activity could damage upgraded roads and tourism sites.
risks.mitigation: Incorporate climate‑resilient engineering (drainage, slope stabilization, seismic design); conduct hazard mapping and third‑party design reviews.
risks.evidence: Key climate and natural hazard risks include heavy rains, flooding, landslides, and high seismic activity affecting infrastructure.

risks.description: Failure to secure required Interinstitutional Agreements with municipalities may block disbursements.
risks.mitigation: Negotiate template agreements early; obtain signatures from all participating municipalities before first disbursement; monitor compliance.
risks.evidence: Disbursement condition: no withdrawals until Bank receives at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements.

risks.description: Fragmented coordination among ministries, regional and local authorities could cause implementation delays.
risks.mitigation: Define clear TORs for steering and consultative committees; schedule regular joint meetings and shared reporting mechanisms.
risks.evidence: Steering and consultative committees are established to coordinate across ministries and levels of government.

risks.description: Complex procurement environment and limited experience may lead to procurement delays or non‑compliance.
risks.mitigation: Finalize Project Procurement Strategy Document; train logistics office staff; use standard WB bidding documents for all procurements.
risks.evidence: Procurement will follow WB regulations; GORE’s logistics office prepared a Project Procurement Strategy Document.

risks.description: Private sector investment may not materialize, reducing leverage and expected job creation.
risks.mitigation: Develop PPP frameworks and investment promotion packages; secure pre‑qualification of private partners; provide fiscal incentives and risk guarantees.
risks.evidence: Private investors are preparing a US$126 million program contingent on upgraded infrastructure and tourism flows.

risks.description: Global tourism demand shocks (e.g., new pandemic, recession) could lower arrivals and revenue.
risks.mitigation: Diversify source markets (domestic, regional, niche); strengthen digital marketing; create flexible tourism products to adapt to demand shifts.
risks.evidence: Tourism contributed 9.3 % of GDP; pandemic caused severe drop; future arrivals depend on global demand.

risks.description: Risks of sexual exploitation and harassment may affect women participants and staff.
risks.mitigation: Enforce SEA/SH Action Plan, conduct awareness training, establish confidential reporting channels, monitor incidents regularly.
risks.evidence: Project includes SEA/SH Action Plan to address sexual exploitation and harassment risks.

risks.description: Construction activities could cause environmental degradation if mitigation measures are insufficient.
risks.mitigation: Implement Environmental Management Plan; use low‑impact construction techniques; monitor reforestation progress; manage waste responsibly.
risks.evidence: Component includes reforestation of 174 ha and mitigation measures such as PV panels and drainage.

risks.description: Delay in signing the Cooperation Agreement between MINCETUR and GORE may postpone fund utilization.
risks.mitigation: Set a firm deadline for signing; assign legal team to track progress; involve Bank liaison to ensure timely execution.
risks.evidence: Cooperation Agreement between MINCETUR and GORE must be signed in form satisfactory to the Bank.

risks.description: Cost overruns on road and infrastructure works could exhaust the allocated budget.
risks.mitigation: Use detailed cost estimates with contingency reserve; conduct independent cost reviews; monitor expenditures monthly and adjust forecasts.
risks.evidence: Road upgrades involve extensive civil works; cost overruns are a common risk in large infrastructure projects.

risks.description: Insufficient maintenance arrangements may lead to rapid degradation of upgraded assets.
risks.mitigation: Create an O&M fund, train local operators, establish maintenance contracts with clear performance indicators.
risks.evidence: Design includes maintenance arrangements to ensure sustainability of improved roads.

risks.description: Inadequate stakeholder engagement could generate grievances and community opposition.
risks.mitigation: Roll out Stakeholder Engagement Plan; hold community workshops; maintain transparent grievance redress mechanism with timely response.
risks.evidence: Borrower must prepare and implement Stakeholder Engagement Plan and grievance mechanism.

risks.description: Political instability or changes in regional leadership may affect project continuity.
risks.mitigation: Obtain multi‑year political commitments; embed project in regional development plan; maintain continuous dialogue with elected officials.
risks.evidence: Recent years have seen increased political instability; project relies on GORE Arequipa governance.

risks.description: Non‑compliance with environmental and social safeguards could trigger Bank sanctions.
risks.mitigation: Develop and implement ESMP; conduct regular compliance audits; provide staff training on safeguards and reporting.
risks.evidence: Environmental and Social Risk Classification is Substantial; FM risk rated Substantial, requiring safeguards compliance.

risks.description: Data gaps for M&E indicators (e.g., lodging arrivals) may impair performance monitoring.
risks.mitigation: Set up dedicated data collection unit; formalize data sharing agreements with MINCETUR/INEI; use digital platform for real‑time monitoring.
risks.evidence: M&E relies on data from MINCETUR, INEI, and new surveys; baseline and periodic data collection required.
